thread:
Jordan M: Hey team — PR #8421 is green locally but CI e2e keeps failing on ubuntu-latest in the kv-cache suite. Can someone take a quick look? Failing job: https://ci.internal/8421/9
Maya R: On it. Kicking a rerun now.
ci-bot: Re-run triggered for job 8421 (attempt 10) by Maya R.
Alex P: I pulled the logs — failing assertion in test_kv_cache.py:128. Stack: 
```
AssertionError: expected 3 tokens, got 2
File "/workspace/tests/test_kv_cache.py", line 128, in test_prefix_warm
    assert len(tokens) == 3
```
Looks like a race around cache warm-up. The PR changed the batching window for prefilling.
Sam T: Could be timing-sensitive across slower CI runners. Maybe add a small wait in test or mock the prefetch?
Maya R: I'll try adding a wait_for_cache_ready() call and rerun the matrix. Quick patch will be less invasive than reverting batching changes.
Jordan M: Sounds good. Hold merging this until the next green. @release-bot can you block the merge queue for #8421?
release-bot: Merge hold placed on PR #8421 by Jordan M.
Alex P: If the sleep fixes it, we should also file an issue to replace sleeps with proper readiness hooks.
Maya R: Agreed — I'll include an issue link in the test-fix commit. Patch PR in ~25–40m. :thumbsup:
Sam T: If you need me to debug runner speed or repro locally, ping me.
Jordan M: Thanks all. Quick note for reviewers: look for the test-only change in tests/test_kv_cache.py and the follow-up issue.
Maya R: Patch up: https://git.internal/pr/8432 — running full CI now.
ci-bot: Job 8432/1 queued.
Maya R: First run passed the kv-cache suite, running full matrix.
Alex P: Great — will review the tiny test fix and LGTM if clean.
Jordan M: Appreciate it — leaving merge hold until CI is green and Alex approves.
Maya R: CI finished ✅. All jobs green.
Alex P: Reviewed and approved. LGTM.
release-bot: Merge hold released for PR #8421 by Alex P.
Jordan M: Merged. Thanks everyone for quick eyes.
Sam T: Nice, thanks Maya and Alex.
Maya R: np :wave:
